caseName: Eckstrom v. Reading Police Home Ass'n
caseNameFull: ECKSTROM v. READING POLICE HOME ASSOCIATION OF READING, PA
attorneys: Charles H. Weidner and Arthur Littleton for appellant.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
